unsupported: Wire Specialties does not manufacture the wire itself but manages distribution and technical support for the Furukawa product range.
Customers include manufacturers of power supplies, transformers, and related electronic equipment that require high-voltage insulation in a small footprint.
The company serves original equipment manufacturers and contract assemblers across North America.

Wire Specialties positions its value on providing a single-source supply for Furukawa’s TEX-E wire, enabling design engineers to achieve significant space and weight savings without additional insulation layers.
